title: Anna Nikolayevsky - The Value of Independent Thought
summary:
The
tactical side requires close attention to the firm’s financials and
prospects, while the structural side puts that analysis in the
specific context of the industry as well as the economy at large. Our guest, Anna Nikolayevsky, is here today to share her approach
and how her investment strategy has evolved. Anna Nikolayevsky is the founder
and Chief Investment Officer of Axel Capital Management, a
fundamentally driven long/short firm investing in equities across a
variety of sectors and geographies.
